title: Currencies & rates
explain: The company's own currency, the currencies its documents may be in, and the exchange rate of each day: the ECB's daily reference rate, or a rate typed for the day, which wins. A document keeps the rate it used; a later rate never changes it. Revaluation stays with your accountant.
noRight: You do not have the right to see currencies and exchange rates (currencies.view).

base.label: Company currency
base.explain: Its books and totals are kept in it; a total never adds two currencies: other currencies count at a named rate, or the total says it cannot. It is changed in Admin › Companies & sites.

currencies.title: Document currencies
currencies.off: Switched off: new documents cannot use it
currencies.waitsExplain: A document in a currency that waits for a rate (an invoice, a purchase order, a credit check, a work order's cost) waits until a rate of its day is kept: switch on the daily ECB rates, or set a rate for the day.

feed.title: Daily ECB rates
feed.explain: The ECB publishes its euro reference rates every working day at about 16:00. While on, they are read at 16:30 and 18:30, Monday to Friday. Off until you switch them on.
feed.fakeExplain: Test mode: the rates read are made up, nothing is fetched from the ECB.

rates.title: Rates per day
rates.explain: Each day's ECB rate and the rate typed for that day side by side; documents of the day take the typed one when there is one. A day without a rate takes the last one of the 7 days before (weekends and bank holidays have none).
rates.set: Set a rate for a day
rates.setForDay: Set a rate for this day
rates.keySet: Set a rate for a day
rates.notManual: Only a day with a typed rate can be picked: the ECB's rate is kept as published
rates.truncated: More rates than one page shows: choose a currency or fewer days.

empty.title: No rates yet
empty.body: Switch on the daily ECB rates, or set a rate for a day.
empty.bodyOn: The daily ECB rates are on: the next working day's arrive after 16:30. You can also read today's now, or set a rate for a day.

problem.same: Choose another currency than the company's own.
problem.future: A rate is kept for today or a day before: the future has no rate yet.
problem.rate: A rate is a number above 0 with at most eight decimals (1.0850).
problem.fix: Fix what the fields say first.

dialog.setTitle: Set a rate for a day
dialog.correctTitle: Correct the typed rate of {pair} on {day}
dialog.explain: How many units of the currency one {base} buys, as the ECB quotes it. It wins over the ECB's rate of that day.
dialog.rateHint: A comma or a dot, at most eight decimals
dialog.readsNone: Type a rate to see how it reads.
dialog.ecb: The ECB's rate of that day: {rate}
dialog.far: This rate is more than 5% away from the ECB's of the same day: check it is not a typing slip.
dialog.everyCompany: Rates serve every company of the group.

remove.body: Those days go back to the ECB's rate. Documents that already kept a rate keep it.

held.noManage: You need currencies.manage for this company
held.noRates: Rates serve every company: you need currencies.manage over every company
held.busy: Wait: the last change is still being saved
held.base: {code} is the company's own currency: it is always on
held.feedOff: Switch on the daily ECB rates first
held.noneLeft: Every currency offered is on already

notice.added: {code} added: documents may be in it now.
notice.off: {code} switched off: new documents cannot use it.
notice.feedOff: Daily ECB rates switched off: the rates kept stay.
notice.read_one: The ECB's rates of {count} day kept.
notice.read_other: The ECB's rates of {count} days kept.
notice.readNothing: Nothing new: the ECB's latest rates are kept already.
notice.removed_one: {count} typed rate removed: that day takes the ECB's again.
notice.removed_other: {count} typed rates removed: those days take the ECB's again.

problem.currencyOn: That currency is one of the company's currencies already.
problem.baseOff: The company's own currency is never switched off.
problem.manualKept: A typed rate is kept for that day already: correct that one instead.
problem.manualGone: That typed rate is not kept any more: the rates were read again.
problem.ecbRow: The ECB's rate is kept as published: type a rate for the day instead.
problem.feedOff: The daily ECB rates are off: switch them on first.
problem.unreadable: The ECB file could not be read now. The rates kept stay as they are; try again later.
problem.database: The change was refused: it clashes with the rates kept. The rates were read again.
problem.moved: Someone changed this meanwhile: it was read again; apply your change once more.
problem.state: This cannot be done as things are now: it was read again.
problem.invalid: Something typed is not accepted: check the fields.
problem.forbidden: You do not have the right to do this.
problem.unavailable: The server is not answering: try again in a moment.
problem.write: The change could not be saved.
